data_notes: Exits at 32 Putrajaya Line stations (Damansara Damai to Putrajaya Sentral) are not recorded in the source; those trips are credited to other stations. Busyness therefore uses entries only, and no flow ends at those stations.
Stations that opened during the period are averaged over the days they have data: the Shah Alam Line (LRT3) opened on 29 June 2026 with free rides until 31 July, so its figures cover August only.

sources.stations: data.gov.my, GTFS Static (Prasarana rapid-rail-kl), CC BY 4.0
